extDescription.message: Automatically closes tabs left behind after links open in desktop apps like Zoom, Slack, Teams and Notion.

pausedBanner.message: Auto-closing is paused. No tabs will be closed.

rulesHelp.message: Rules are checked top to bottom; the first match wins. Drag to reorder, or focus a handle and use ↑/↓.

noRules.message: No rules yet. Add one, or pick from the presets below.

fieldIncludeHelp.message: One regular expression per line, tested case-insensitively against the full URL.

fieldExcludeHelp.message: Optional. One regular expression per line.

timeoutWarning.message: Timeouts over $P1$s rely on browser alarms and may run a few seconds late.

presetsHelp.message: Built-in rules for apps that hand links off to a desktop client. Presets you haven't edited are updated automatically.

presetZoom.message: Meeting links, once Zoom reports the desktop client launched (#success).

presetSlack.message: Links to messages and channels that open in the Slack app.

presetTeams.message: The "Open in Teams" launcher page for meeting and chat links.

presetNotion.message: Redirect pages when "Open links in desktop app" is on. Notion also has its own "Close redirecting browser tabs" setting.

presetDiscord.message: Server invite pages. Accepting an invite in the browser cancels the close.

presetLinear.message: Issue links after Linear hands them to the desktop app.

presetFigma.message: Design, file, board and slides links.

presetSpotify.message: Track, album, playlist, episode, show and artist links.

presetWarningNoMarker.message: This app's handoff pages look identical to normal browser use, so this also closes tabs you open on purpose. Only enable it if you never use the web version.

importReplace.message: Replace existing rules instead of merging

errImportFormat.message: Expected an App Tab Cleaner export (version $P1$).
